title: GMPC: Geometric Model Predictive Control for Wheeled Mobile Robot Trajectory Tracking
verified_design: Circle and butterfly trajectories; two wheel-based platforms; randomized initial poses; GMPC vs NMPC vs feedback linearization; linearization comparison
sample_unit: Monte Carlo count not explicitly verified in the experiment prose
lesson: Tracking controller validation is separate from cluttered dynamic navigation; borrowed GMPC is not a new contribution.

title: Benchmarking Metric Ground Navigation
verified_design: 300 environments x 2 planners x 5 trials = 3000 simulation runs; additional 50 physical runs
lesson: Vary geometry and difficulty; normalize time and report failed attempts.

title: DynaBARN: Benchmarking Metric Ground Navigation in Dynamic Environments
verified_design: 300 generated environments; motion profile variation; DWA, TEB, TD3, BC; each baseline is deployed 10 times per evaluated environment
sample_unit: Do not infer total evaluated runs by multiplying the full released dataset
lesson: Vary obstacle speed, speed changes and path shape, not just obstacle count.

title: A Holistic Approach to Reactive Mobile Manipulation
verified_design: 1000 reachable targets per reaching comparison; 10 physical pick-place rounds, 100 objects, 113 grasp attempts
sample_unit: reachable pose; task round; object; grasp attempt are distinct
lesson: Use an external whole-body QP baseline; separate local reaching from task-level execution and retries.

title: An Architecture for Reactive Mobile Manipulation On-The-Move
verified_design: 10 repeats per configuration; static and dynamic objects; proposed method has 120 attempts across two physical experiments; sequential reactive and planned on-the-move baselines
sample_unit: configuration repeat and repeated transport operation are distinct
lesson: Compare efficiency with a feasible sequential strategy and report acceleration, failures and task boundaries.

title: Reactive Base Control for On-The-Move Mobile Manipulation in Dynamic Environments
verified_design: 50 simulated object arrangements; repeat those 50 with two added static obstacles; dynamic results include case studies; 10 physical task trials separately reported
sample_unit: object arrangement/task rollout, not object pickup count
lesson: Pair exact arrangements; dynamic case demonstrations do not substitute for paired dynamic performance trials.

title: Articulated Object Interaction in Unknown Scenes with Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation
sections: Author project: Simulation deployment; Interaction evaluation
verified_design: Different kitchen layouts; articulated objects; whole-body planner; static and dynamic scenes; grasp-location interaction evaluation
sample_unit: Exact trial count not verified from this primary project page
lesson: Test door/drawer geometry and environment clearance separately; do not invent a trial count.
